liebermann.notes: Written in one hand c. 1330, once owned by the London Guildhall and then by Francis Tate; a codex of the London Leges Anglorum (see Lond), mostly closer to Co than K, taking many insertions added in Co into its text; Gi mostly reads like Or. Contents: Expositio vocabulorum, Numerus provinciarum, Quadripartitus texts (Ine, Alfred, Æthelstan, etc.), Iudicium Dei XVI, I, XV, Cnut, then Tripartita (rubric list, Wl art retr, ECf retr with London interpolations, Genealogia Normannica), and Henry I's laws with his coronation and London charters.

entries.text_de:
Oxford, Oriel College 46, in Einer Hand um 1330, einst der Londoner Guildhall, dann Fr. Tate gehörig, ist ein Codex der Leges Anglorum s. XIII. in. Lond. coll.1 (s. o. Lond), der zumeist Co näher steht als K, namentlich viele in Co nachgetragene Einschiebsel in den Text nimmt. Meist wie Or lautet Gi. — F. 1 Expositio vocabulorum; f. 2 Numerus provinciarum, hidarum2.

Dann aus Quadripartitus: f. 2b Ine, u. S. 89; f. 5 Blas, Forf, Hu, u. S. 389. 192; f. 5b Af von Einl. 49, 9 ab, u. S. 47; f. 8 AGu, u. S. 127; f. 9 App. AGu, u. S. 394; f. 10 EGu, I As, u. S. 129. 147; f. 11 As Alm, II As, u. S. 148. 151; f. 12 Episc, u. S. 477; Norðleod, Mirce, Að, Had, u. S. 459—65; f. 13 IV. V. III. VI As, u. S. 171. 167. 170. 173; f. 15b Ordal, u. S. 386.

F. 16 18b Iud Dei XVI. I. XV, u. S. 427. 401. 427.

Wieder aus Quadr.: f. 19 Cnut, u. S. 279.

Aus Tripartita: f. 27 Rubrikenliste zu Wl art retr und ECf retr, Wl art retr, u. S. 489; f. 28b ECf retr Lond interpol., u. S. 627; f. 37b Geneal. Normann.

F. 39 Hn, u. S. 547 mit CHn cor und Hn Lond, u. S. 521. 524.
entries.text_en:
Oxford, Oriel College 46, in one hand, c. 1330, formerly belonging to the London Guildhall, then to Fr. Tate, is a codex of the Leges Anglorum s. XIII. in. Lond. coll.1 (see above, Lond), which mostly stands nearer to Co than to K, in particular taking into its text many insertions added later in Co. Gi mostly reads like Or. — F. 1 Expositio vocabulorum; f. 2 Numerus provinciarum, hidarum2.

Then from Quadripartitus: f. 2b Ine, below, p. 89; f. 5 Blas, Forf, Hu, below, pp. 389. 192; f. 5b Af from Introd. 49, 9 onwards, below, p. 47; f. 8 AGu, below, p. 127; f. 9 App. AGu, below, p. 394; f. 10 EGu, I As, below, pp. 129. 147; f. 11 As Alm, II As, below, pp. 148. 151; f. 12 Episc, below, p. 477; Norðleod, Mirce, Að, Had, below, pp. 459—65; f. 13 IV. V. III. VI As, below, pp. 171. 167. 170. 173; f. 15b Ordal, below, p. 386.

F. 16 18b Iud Dei XVI. I. XV, below, pp. 427. 401. 427.

Again from Quadr.: f. 19 Cnut, below, p. 279.

From Tripartita: f. 27 list of rubrics to Wl art retr and ECf retr, Wl art retr, below, p. 489; f. 28b ECf retr Lond interpol., below, p. 627; f. 37b Geneal. Normann.

F. 39 Hn, below, p. 547, with CHn cor and Hn Lond, below, pp. 521. 524.
